_comment: Single source of truth for the tower geometry. tools/gen-runtime-map.js and tools/gen-terrain.ps1 both read this, so the node positions and the carved rooms can never drift apart.
_southPad_comment: v0.7.94: the draft spawn is at z=0. The south edge is z=8, with a two-block wall at z=9..10. Previous south walls through z=34 remain in the clear range.
_sealBlock_comment: v0.6.25: permanent door seals use a VISIBLE block so the player can see at a glance which rooms are off-limits (can't enter / can't go back). The temporary battle lock (terrain/lock) still uses barrier on purpose, so it does not look like a permanent wall.
